company.description: Brand Ripplr is an online marketplace which simplifies the entire influencer marketing process for businesses. Brand Ripplr is an influencer marketing and creator collaboration platform focused on helping brands build impactful social media campaigns across MENA and global markets. The platform connects businesses with relevant influencers, manages campaign execution, tracks engagement metrics, and provides performance analytics. Brand Ripplr enables companies to improve brand visibility, audience engagement, and marketing ROI through data-driven creator partnerships and streamlined influencer campaign management solutions.
